subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: Under standard public procurement principles, in which competitive method is the negotiation of scope, specifications, or terms strictly prohibited prior to award?
questions.explain: Competitive sealed bidding (IFB) requires an award to the lowest responsive and responsible bidder exactly as specified in the bid documents. Post-bid negotiation is fundamentally prohibited to maintain a fair, apples-to-apples sealed process.
